facts.text: URReachEnv is a Gymnasium environment (a gym.Env subclass) for a UR5e reach task.
URReachEnv resolves MuJoCo Menagerie models from $MUJOCO_MENAGERIE_PATH or ~/mujoco_menagerie and raises FileNotFoundError when that directory is absent.
URReachEnv models six UR5e joints and composes a 15-number observation from six joint positions, six joint velocities and three target coordinates.
The normalized joint-velocity action space is a six-element Box with low -1.0 and high 1.0.
Each upstream action is scaled by 0.5 to rad/s and advances the MuJoCo model with five mj_step calls.
URReachEnv stores the model timestep multiplied by five as its _dt attribute.
On reset the environment restores the MuJoCo data and samples the target radius from 0.2 to 0.55, the azimuth from -pi/2 to pi/2 and the elevation from 0.1 to pi/2.
The step reward is the negative end-effector-to-target distance plus 1.0 when that distance is below 0.05.
The episode terminates when the end-effector-to-target distance is below 0.02 and truncates after the simulated time exceeds 10.0 s.
render() lazily launches a passive MuJoCo viewer when render_mode is human, and close() closes that viewer.

determinism.notes: the fake seeds a Python random.Random from reset(seed); it exposes no state snapshot

gaps: the fake is a package stand-in: it does not run MuJoCo, load the universal_robots_ur5e/ur5e.xml and robotiq_2f85/2f85.xml Menagerie models, or model contacts, a gripper or rigid-body dynamics

the upstream environment needs MuJoCo and a mujoco_menagerie checkout at $MUJOCO_MENAGERIE_PATH or ~/mujoco_menagerie (ur_reach_env.py:11-23); neither is installed here and the gate never runs upstream code

the fake returns a 15-number observation (six placeholder joint positions, six placeholder joint velocities, three placeholder target coordinates) matching the upstream size, but the values are test data and do not reproduce MuJoCo state
the fake does not model the upstream reward, termination or truncation criteria; it reports a placeholder distance reward and returns terminated and truncated as false
the fake has no physics timestep, contacts, rendering or viewer and no wall-clock pacing; upstream _dt is the model timestep times five (ur_reach_env.py:56)
the fake exposes no get_state/set_state, so the bridge cannot take exact snapshots and declares seeded rather than exact determinism

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: The software latch refuses subsequent world steps; it does not reset the episode or resample the target. An in-flight native step is not a physical stop; the simulated environment has no hardware output.
